newsitem.title: GERMANY: EU's Van Miert may allow VW subsidies-paper.
newsitem.headline: EU's Van Miert may allow VW subsidies-paper.

text.p: European Union Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert is ready under certain conditions to allow state subsidies for Volkswagen AG plants in the east German state of Saxony, a newspaper said on Sunday.

In an advance copy of an interview to be published on Monday, the Leipziger Volkszeitung said Van Miert believed greater investment in east Germany by the car-maker could make the transfer of further public funds justifiable.
Another possibility would be the reduction of capacity at VW plants elsewhere, he said, adding though that this "was probably not the best solution."
The EU is in dispute with VW and the state of Saxony over some 240 million marks of public funds paid to VW despite a ban on such subsidies by the European Commission.
Van Miert is due to speak in Leipzig on Monday on matters of European policy.
